emailTracking.privacyNote: Applo screens incoming mail locally first: only messages that match one of your applications are processed further. For those, the sender, subject and a text excerpt go to our AI provider. No email text is stored — only sender, subject and the classification result, deleted automatically after 180 days (see privacy policy).

consent.title: Connect mailbox
consent.intro: Before you connect your mailbox, here is what happens:
consent.scope: Microsoft grants Applo read access to your mailbox (Mail.Read). That access cannot technically be limited to individual senders.
consent.prefilter: Every incoming message is screened locally first. Only if the sender or subject matches one of your applications is it processed further — everything else is discarded immediately.
consent.llm: For matching messages, the sender, subject and a text excerpt (max. 1,200 characters) are sent to our AI provider (Microsoft Azure OpenAI, EU) for classification.
consent.stored: We store only sender, subject, receipt time and the classification result — never the email text. These entries are deleted automatically after 180 days.
consent.revoke: You can disconnect at any time here; we then also revoke the access at Microsoft.
